newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom says 1996 pretax profit 45.09 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom says 1996 pretax profit 45.09 trln rbls.

text.p: Russian natural gas group Gazprom said 1996 pretax profit was 45.09 trillion roubles ($7.8 billion) and net profit was 33.22 trillion roubles in an official notification published in Trud newspaper on Wednesday.

A Gazprom spokesman was unable to say to what accounting standards the figures were calculated and whether they were calculated on the same basis as 1995 results released by Gazprom, which showed pretax profit to international IAS standards at 19.64 trillion roubles. AK&M securities specialists said on Tuesday Gazprom 1995 pretax profit was 38.37 trillion roubles but did not specify the accounting standards. ($ = 5762 Russian Roubles)
